title: Faster Build Battle starts and true replays
summary: Build Battle now starts sooner, keeps rematches in the right game, makes judging fairer and exposes more creative tools across Java and Bedrock.
body:
- Once two builders are ready, the pre-game countdown is now 15 seconds instead of 30.
- The replay button now queues another Build Battle instead of falling back to global Quick Play.
- Judging is now anonymous until the results, helping every creation get a fairer vote.
- The `/bbitems` cross-play palette now includes paintings, safe redstone, lava and a wider selection of passive mobs.
- All existing safety limits for entities, fluids and redstone remain in place.
